sources.content: # CLAUDE.md for Rendwell. Rendwell is a batch job scheduler that places jobs on a pool of worker nodes. The scheduler core is Go 1.23 in `internal/sched/`, and the gRPC API definitions are in `proto/rendwell/v1/`. After editing any `.proto` file, run `make proto` to regenerate the Go stubs, and commit the generated files. Run tests with `go test ./...`. The simulator in `cmd/rendsim/` replays a recorded cluster trace and is the main tool for checking placement changes.

Rules. Placement code must stay deterministic: never iterate over a Go map when the order affects which node is picked; sort keys first. Do not import `internal/sched` from `cmd/` packages other than `cmd/rendwell`. Time comes from the `clock.Clock` interface, never from time.Now directly, so tests can control it. Any change to scoring weights in `internal/sched/score.go` must include simulator results in the pull request description. Log with the slog package, using structured key and value pairs.

claims.text: After editing a `.proto` file in Rendwell, you run `make proto`.
Rendwell's generated Go stubs should not be committed.
Rendwell code reads time through the `clock.Clock` interface.
Changes to Rendwell scoring weights must include simulator results in the pull request description.
Rendwell placement code may pick a node by iterating over an unsorted Go map.
The Rendwell scheduler core is written in Go 1.23.
